blocks.label: Current Beat
blocks.body: Four figures rise from the brush in a clatter of breaking branches: ragged, wiry, armored in lashed river-stone and thorn. Their blades are mismatched, half of them salvaged. A fifth hangs back, sharper-eyed, clearly the one giving orders. They do not whoop...

blocks.label: Public Objective
blocks.body: Survive the ambush and protect the carriage and the package.

affordances: Ask one practical question before acting.
